expected_findings.root_cause: refers_to_previous_turn matches the regex against the raw question instead of question.lower(), so capitalised reference words are missed
expected_findings.failure_path: a follow-up that starts with a capitalised reference word, such as 'That again?', and whose own retrieval is weak: the regex only matches lowercase letters, so the word set misses 'That', refers_to_previous_turn returns False, the retry with the previous question is skipped, and the user sees the abstention message instead of an answer to the follow-up; a lowercase phrasing of the same question would have been retried
